messages:
Marco Alvarez: Heads-up: all-hands at 11:00am PT tomorrow. Main items: Security baseline update + Launch readiness checklist for Release 0.9.0. Please drop any questions here. Recording and slides will be shared after.
Hannah Lee: Q: will release 0.9.0 include new quantization support in the release notes?
Vikram Rao: can we include a short demo of the health dashboard for the new routing policy?
Samantha Cole: Security update: we'll cover the baseline changes and mention the new secrets rotation cadence (30 days). Will call out any customer-facing impacts.
metrics-bot: New KPI: median p99 latency per model now tracked in Console under /observability/latency.
Marco Alvarez: Agenda:
 - 11:00 Exec updates (Marco)
 - 11:12 Security baseline + secrets cadence (Samantha)
 - 11:25 Release 0.9.0 readiness + quantization notes (Hannah)
 - 11:40 Health dashboard demo (Infra)
 - 11:50 Q&A
-- (after meeting) --
Marco Alvarez: Recording & slides: https://redwood.slack.com/files/KLMNO12345/all-hands-1860016789.mp4
Hannah Lee: Release notes uploaded: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/0.9.0. Quantization support included, plus API changes for decoder hooks.
Samantha Cole: Security actions: rotated a set of service keys as part of the rollout; customers on Private with KMS must update their integration by next week.
Vikram Rao: follow-up: added a ticket to infra backlog to add routing policy toggles in Console.
Marco Alvarez: TL;DR: security cadence tightened, release 0.9.0 includes quantization and decoder hooks, health dashboard demo + next steps. Action items in the slides. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
